text: Exploration presentation use different renderers. uPlot/canvas prioritizes latency; short selected segments can rendered SVG precise print cross-channel markup. consume samples, annotations, bookmark state. ggm_scene declarative, serializable scene graph plus timeline. Responsibility boundary: ggm_scene: semantic objects, timing, explicit final state. SVG compiler: traces, arrows, calipers, labels, channel layout. anime.js: interpolation timeline playback . Exporter: SVG/PDF explicit final state; animated HTML scene plus anime.js. boundary keeps R grammar stable JavaScript runtime changes. also ensures print still depend replaying animation discover elements finish. Vendor one pinned anime.js v4 build inst/htmlwidgets/lib/. Keep selectors, timeline positions, anime.js option names inside compiler rather public R object. Presentation layers: trace, marker, label, arrow, caliper, highlight, inset. Camera operations: reveal, pan, zoom, hold, transition. scene resolves referenced annotations rendering fails clearly missing ambiguous. title: ggm: Grammar of Electrograms — Design Blueprint
text: Record every settled decision one-line rationale don’t reopen accident. Add new ones D-N. D-1 DECIDED — WFDB binary stays canonical; pyramid derived sidecar. Rationale: byte-seek reads beat columnar raw signal; overview gap, ’s regenerable. D-2 DECIDED — Pyramid storage Parquet, partitioned (channel, tier). Rationale: Arrow ecosystem + optional DuckDB queries coarse data + clean partitioning. Stores derived downsample tiers (+ manifest, + optional min/max envelopes), never raw .dat samples. Renderer- independent — uPlot never sees -disk format (§3.5). substrate Shiny renders, embeddable later via auto-generated output/render pair rewrite (JS↔︎R channel M4 editing needs). Shiny-module-first path rejected: confine renderer running app, losing console/Quarto/print-export reach presentation engine wants. D-4 OPEN — Interval syntax grammar: indexed VA[1] vs span(V, ). D-5 DECIDED — Presentation layout single coordinate space (channels stacked vertical offset), faceted ggplot. Rationale: cross-channel arrows (V→) can’t drawn across facets even still; motivating VOP/SVT figure requires . D-6 DECIDED — print still terminal frame animation. One composition, exported vector timeline end. Rationale: eliminates whole class static-vs-animated mismatch; polished slide teaching reveal object. D-7 DECIDED — SVG + GSAP sole presentation engine. gganimate dropped — one job (data-state subplots) just another SVG element; faceted ggplot part presentation. Rationale: §5.0/§5.4 — facets can’t cross-panel marks; GSAP already timeline engine; one engine removes dependency two-renderers-must-match risk, keeping print-still = terminal-frame (D-6) airtight. (Supersedes earlier “gganimate demoted” form.) D-8 DECIDED — Sample index (integer) canonical key; time (seconds) display unit. Conversion via fs header exact; data-access API takes time, computes samples, returns . Rationale: exactness + clean joins .dat/annotations + WFDB-native, matching users think (). (§3.0) D-9 DECIDED — zoomed-overview two layers: faint signal (signal pyramid) + sharp event pyramid aggregates annotations (runs→spans, sparse→density bins, individual marks zoom-). Detectors populate (e.g. pacing-train) deferred arrive candidate annotators (<record>.train) — viewer changes needed. (§3.3b)
